extraction_notes: Digitised SI catalytic-performance figures only. SI Figures S21-S27 and S29 are stability/time-on-stream plots; per instruction, only the first and last plotted points of each series were extracted. SI Figure S28 was extracted as a WHSV-dependent bar/line plot. SI Figure S49 is an illustration/schematic and was skipped. Other SI figures are characterisation, GC/NMR traces, DFT/modelled energy diagrams, or tables and were not extracted.
